description: This source file defines a class `MotionTokens` containing static constants for durations and curves used in animations, as well as a method to adjust durations based on system settings for reduced motion. It centralizes motion-related tokens for the StreamEase platform.

classes.name: MotionTokens
classes.description: A class providing predefined motion tokens such as durations and curves for animations, along with a utility method to adapt durations for reduced motion preferences.

methods.name: reduceMotionDuration
methods.description: Adjusts the input duration to a shorter duration if the user has requested reduced motion via system settings, maintaining a minimum threshold to prevent abrupt changes.
